account_strategy: Coordinate Nick’s Genius bid team with Worldpay’s Subway relationship manager Stacey as one internal team. The September 15 first JPR call says the RFP excludes POS, Nick is on daily RFP calls, and price plus the current-versus-next-generation kiosk decision are central. Bid only kiosk/KDS, installation/managed services, and/or DMB scopes that can be fully answered and priced by September 22, with an internal draft target of September 18. Lead with integration to SubwayPOS, Subway Payment Manager, FreedomPay, Canopy MDM and Fresh Connect, realistic rollout capacity, and franchisee-level total cost. Reconcile the first call’s reports of unanswered outreach to a new Subway technology leader, a departed Subway contact, possible NCR activity, and a later PAR loss before using them in competitive or access strategy. Keep all event-related customer contact within Subway’s Rules of Engagement. Treat the 25-versus-200-store 2026 phasing conflict, missing kiosk integration, blank pricing, and incomplete bid roster as submission gates.
